name: audit-record-corrections
brief: Correct six stale or inaccurate statements in the audit register, docs/audit/00-master-index.md and docs/audit/01-domain-application.md, one per unscheduled backlog row at .sir/backlog.md:179, :182, :183, :184, :190 and :191, then remove those rows at Gate 3. Every correction is an insertion, never a rewrite: T1 adds four dated inline spans to the MASTER-081, -119, -130 and -178 cells, and T2 adds four AMENDED blocks at the end of CORE-016, -022, -024 and -035. The facts each correction states were re-measured at c90da08 and frozen in contract C1 with their commands. Classifications were settled from git history by the orchestrator: rows 182, 183 and 191 are DRIFT, and 179 and 190 are ERROR (attribution). Row 184 reconciles five zero-member wordings on one shared reading. A Python checker, ARC, proves both files keep LONE_CR 0 and that removing the insertions restores the base sha256 exactly. No source, test or build change.
